# Netcraft DDW Intelligence — Operations

Latest Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches (`com.netcraft.deep_and_dark_web.match.discovered`) from the Integration Gateway (`NetcraftDdwIntelligence_CL`). Use `NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest` so re-delivered events collapse to one row per `MatchUuid`.

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by Priority
| order by Events desc
content.title: Matches by priority

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by IntelligenceType
| order by Events desc
content.title: Matches by intelligence type

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    HighPriority = countif(Priority == "high"),
    TakedownEligible = countif(TakedownEligible == true),
    Unacknowledged = countif(Acknowledged == false)
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "High priority", "Count", HighPriority),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Takedown eligible", "Count", TakedownEligible),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Unacknowledged", "Count", Unacknowledged))
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Count = tolong(Metrics.Count)
content.title: Highlights (high / takedown-eligible / unacknowledged)

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by MatchSource
| order by Events desc
| take 20
content.title: Top match sources

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Priority
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume over time

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Priority == "high"
| project TimeGenerated, MatchUuid, GroupUuid, IntelligenceType, DisplayValue, Priority, Acknowledged, TakedownEligible, MatchSource, Url, Rule, MatchCreated, CloudEventType
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: High-priority matches

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where TakedownEligible == true
| project TimeGenerated, MatchUuid, GroupUuid, IntelligenceType, DisplayValue, Priority, Acknowledged, MatchSource, Url, DdwUrl, MatchCreated, CloudEventType
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Takedown-eligible matches

content.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, MatchUuid, GroupUuid, IntelligenceType, DisplayValue, Priority, Acknowledged, TakedownEligible, MatchSource, Url, Rule, Snippet, MatchCreated, CloudEventType
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Latest matches
